newsitem.title: CHINA: China to invite foreign bids for Bohai oil permits.
newsitem.headline: China to invite foreign bids for Bohai oil permits.

text.p: Foreign companies would be invited in the next few months to explore the Qinhuangdao 32-6 area in the Bohai Bay, the Business Daily said on Sunday.
Bidding will begin in September, said the newspaper, published by the official China Daily.

An increasing number of Western companies have been attracted to the Bohai Bay area by a growing number of new discoveries. At least 10 wells were expected to be drilled in the bay this year and seven more oilfields developed.
The latest high-profile find in the bay was reported by the U.S. Kerr-Mcgee Corp, which said on Friday that a well in the bay tested at a rate of 4,100 barrels of light oil per day.
